info.title: Axum Production API
info.description: Production-ready Axum API scaffold: session-backed auth, RBAC, apps, organizations, owned storage with signed URLs, rate limiting, idempotency, metrics, cross-replica realtime, notifications, and an append-only audit log

get.description:
Access requires one of: the file being public, a bearer token for its owner
or an administrator, or a valid unexpired signature. Callers who fail all
three get 404 rather than 403, so this cannot be used to probe for file IDs.

get.description:
Events reach this replica through the Postgres listener, so a client here
receives events published by any replica. Dropped events are surfaced as an
explicit `lagged` event rather than silently discarded, which lets a client
know it must re-fetch instead of assuming it is up to date.

get.summary: Retained as an alias for readiness, so existing probes keep working.
Liveness: is the process running? Deliberately does not touch the database.
get.description:
A single endpoint that checks dependencies makes an orchestrator restart pods
during a database blip, which removes capacity exactly when the database is
already struggling. Liveness and readiness must answer different questions.

get.summary:
Readiness: can this instance serve traffic? Fails the instance out of the
load balancer without restarting it.

get.description:
Requires `METRICS_TOKEN` when one is configured, which production always is.
Route inventory, traffic volume and error rates are internal information and
were previously served to anyone.

FileRecord.description:
A stored object. Uploads were previously untracked on disk, which left the
filename as the only access-control mechanism; ownership and visibility now
live in this row and every read and delete is authorized against it.

OAuthCallbackQuery.description:
The `state` parameter is required: it is checked against the pending
authorization request this server issued.

state.description: Echo of the CSRF state, for clients that want to correlate the redirect.

PresignedUploadResponse.description:
A genuinely signed upload grant. The previous implementation returned a static
path with no signature and an advertised expiry that nothing enforced.

upload_url.description: Absolute URL carrying the signature and expiry as query parameters.

RefreshTokenRequest.description:
Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token. The refresh token itself is
rotated on every use, so a stolen-and-replayed token is detectable.
